meta.note: Real weights of the trained pilot, sampled: per column the units with the largest weight norm, per block the strongest connections by |w| (sign kept, w normalised by the block's max |w|, raw max in max_abs). Camera dots are the 27 pixels of the first conv's 3×3×3 receptive field at the image centre. Stem convs 2-3 use kernels summed over space. state->tokens and the attention 'OV circuit' (out_proj·W_v·LayerNorm gain) are linear compositions; MLP->next attention is OV·linear2; the head uses [mu.0;v.0]·final-norm gain·linear2. Not drawn: attention pattern (Q·K softmax), residual skips, biases, nonlinearities (SiLU/GELU) inside compositions, CLS and positional encoding. Each edge's source matrix is in edges[].matrix.
